title: Linear Transformations Lab
description: Interactive companion to Chapter 4 of Leon, Linear Algebra with Applications: linear maps, kernel and range, standard matrices, composition, computer graphics in homogeneous coordinates, matrices relative to bases, similarity.
lede: A matrix is a machine that moves the whole plane. Test whether a map is linear by watching what it does to a grid, see the kernel collapse to the origin, build a standard matrix by dragging the images of e₁ and e₂, animate a figure with homogeneous coordinates, and watch one operator take different matrices in different bases.
